preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 200.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 200.
The number of chips k must be between 1 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sx_i <= n and 1 <= sy_i <= m for sx_i, sy_i in starting_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting positions of the chips must be within the bounds of the board.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fx_i <= n and 1 <= fy_i <= m for fx_i, fy_i in final_positions)
preconditions.description: All final positions of the chips must be within the bounds of the board.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(operations) <= 2 * n * m and all(op in 'LRDU' for op in operations))
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to visit all final positions, output -1. Otherwise, output the number of operations and the sequence of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(any(abs(sx_i - fx_i) + abs(sy_i - fy_i) <= 2 * n * m for sx_i, sy_i in starting_positions) for fx_i, fy_i in final_positions)
postconditions.description: Each chip must be able to reach its final position within the allowed number of operations.
